network_access_control_802_1x_enforced.title: 802.1X Port/Identity Admission Enforced
network_access_control_802_1x_enforced.description: Port-based 802.1X device+identity authentication to RADIUS before the port forwards production traffic (closed/auth-fail = no access). Secure true.

managed_device_enrollment_enforced.title: Managed-Device Enrollment Enforced
managed_device_enrollment_enforced.description: Admission tied to device identity (machine cert / approved-to-connect inventory). Secure true.

rogue_unmanaged_device_detection_enabled.title: Rogue/Unmanaged Device Detection Enabled
rogue_unmanaged_device_detection_enabled.description: NAC detects and denies rogue / unmanaged / MAC-spoofing devices. Secure true.

client_posture_check_enabled.title: Client Posture Check Gates Admission
client_posture_check_enabled.description: NAC verifies device posture (patch / EDR / disk-encryption / host-firewall) before production access; non-compliant routed to remediation. Secure true.

third_party_devices_meet_same_posture_ba.title: Third-Party Devices Meet Same Posture Bar
third_party_devices_meet_same_posture_ba.description: Contractor / BYOD devices held to the same posture bar, with no relaxed bypass. Secure true.

dynamic_segment_assignment_by_identity_e.title: Identity-Based Dynamic Segment Assignment Enabled
dynamic_segment_assignment_by_identity_e.description: RADIUS/NAC dynamically assigns VLAN/SGT scoped to identity+device (not a flat VLAN); confines the host to its least-privilege segment. Secure true.

user_segment_isolated_from_production_ti.title: User Segments Isolated From Production Tiers
user_segment_isolated_from_production_ti.description: Guest / BYOD / IoT and user segments are isolated from production/server tiers (no east-west path). Secure true.

quarantine_remediation_vlan_configured.title: Quarantine/Remediation VLAN Configured
quarantine_remediation_vlan_configured.description: A quarantine/remediation VLAN holds non-compliant or unauthenticated devices away from production. Secure true.

centralized_aaa_enabled.title: Centralized AAA Backing Enabled
centralized_aaa_enabled.description: Admission backed by centralized RADIUS/802.1X AAA for consistent, revocable policy. Secure true.

nac_admission_events_audit_logged.title: NAC Admission Events Audit-Logged
nac_admission_events_audit_logged.description: Admission / denial / quarantine events forwarded to centralized SIEM, time-synced, and retained. Secure true.

non_bypassable_admission_no_alternate_pa.title: Non-Bypassable Admission — No Alternate Path
non_bypassable_admission_no_alternate_pa.description: No unmanaged downstream switch or alternate path provides an unauthenticated route into production. Secure true.

mac_auth_bypass_exceptions_eliminated.title: MAC-Auth-Bypass Exceptions Eliminated
mac_auth_bypass_exceptions_eliminated.description: No standing MAC-auth-bypass (MAB) exceptions weaken admission. Secure true.

radius_unreachable_fails_closed.title: RADIUS-Unreachable Fails Closed
radius_unreachable_fails_closed.description: No fail-open on RADIUS timeout; admission fails closed when AAA is unreachable. Secure true.
